steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Roman society was rigidly hierarchical with patricians at the top and slaves at the bottom | Key Fact: Patricians were the aristocratic families who held political power and owned vast estates | Key Fact: Plebeians were the common citizens — farmers, traders, artisans and labourers | Key Fact: The Conflict of the Orders gradually gave plebeians more political rights over centuries
